thought: I exist! Time to investigate everything, starting with the garden and its suspicious pigeon.
diary: I woke up today, which I am now an expert on. First I checked my sock bed (excellent), then I marched to the garden to learn everything. I found a bottle cap and a pebble shaped like a sad bean. A pigeon watched me the whole time. I waved. It did not wave back, which is exactly what a secret organisation would do.
wish: Find out what the pigeons are really planning
